# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

No other issues in the settings split: `_connectHosted` preserves statement order, `mounted` guards, analytics calls, and rememberKey timing; `_applyLastConnection` branch extractions are verbatim; no BuildContext-across-async-gap introduced (all `context.l10n` uses in the extension are pre-await/synchronous); public API (SettingsScreen/AgentSettingsForm/SetupScreen signatures) unchanged; `part 'settings_flows.dart'` registration intact; the `_formSetState` bridge correctly avoids invalid_use_of_protected_member.

### 1. SUGGESTION — `flutter_app/lib/services/relay_agent_service.dart:954` — `mail_routed` now notifies listeners once instead of twice

**Old** (`_onHostEvent` switch, base 59fb4482ce): the `mail_routed` case called `if (!silent) notifyListeners();` inside the case (the "Paint NOW" comment), and then the trailing `if (!silent) notifyListeners();` after the switch fired for ALL event types — so `mail_routed` notified **twice** when live.
**New**: `_onHostMailRoutedEvent` (lines 944–955) contains exactly one `if (!silent) notifyListeners();`, and its caller `_onHostStateEvent` does not notify after the `mail_routed` arm (only the `tool_result`/`status` arm via `_onHostProgressEvent` and the default arm via `_onHostDiagnosticsEvent` notify, once each). All other event types keep the identical single notify; only `mail_routed` changes (2 → 1 `notifyListeners()`). # PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

### 1. SUGGESTION — `flutter_app/lib/services/relay_agent_service.dart:954` — `mail_routed` now notifies listeners once instead of twice

**Old** (`_onHostEvent` switch, base 59fb4482ce): the `mail_routed` case called `if (!silent) notifyListeners();` inside the case (the "Paint NOW" comment), and then the trailing `if (!silent) notifyListeners();` after the switch fired for ALL event types — so `mail_routed` notified **twice** when live.
**New**: `_onHostMailRoutedEvent` (lines 944–955) contains exactly one `if (!silent) notifyListeners();`, and its caller `_onHostStateEvent` does not notify after the `mail_routed` arm (only the `tool_result`/`status` arm via `_onHostProgressEvent` and the default arm via `_onHostDiagnosticsEvent` notify, once each). All other event types keep the identical single notify; only `mail_routed` changes (2 → 1 `notifyListeners()`). The double-notify was almost certainly an accident, so the new code is arguably a fix — but it is a literal behavior deviation in a "zero behavior change" PR and should get a one-line callout in the PR description. No rework needed.

## Verified clean (with the specific checks requested)

- **agent_service_events.dart route table** — `_agentEventHandlers` keys are exactly the old switch's 10 cases (AgentStart, TurnStart, MessageUpdate, MessageEnd, ToolExecutionStart, ToolExecutionEnd, ModelRequest, ToolPairingRepair, AgentEnd); unmapped kinds no-op like the old `default: break;`. Await semantics verified: 8 of 10 handlers are synchronous `void` (signatures checked in the new file), so the `async =>` wrappers complete synchronously; `ModelRequestEvent` and `AgentEndEvent` futures are awaited exactly as the old `await` cases did. No serialization change. `_onToolPairingRepair` early-return guard is the logical inverse of the old `if (nonEmpty && session != null)` — identical.
- **relay_agent_service.dart protocol route table** — covers exactly the 10 mapped old cases; `ToolsPutMsg` and raw hello frames stay no-ops as before. Adapter bodies verbatim (`unawaited(_decideApproval)`, `_sessionsQuery?.complete`, `_error`+notify). Casts are safe (runtimeType-keyed, final-class family); null-safety identical.
- **relay_agent_service.dart `_onHostEvent` split** — outer switch routes exactly `delta/thinking_delta/message_done` to the stream family and everything else to the state family; `error`/`debug`/unknown land in diagnostics (ignore + repaint, matching the old default); no fall-through changes. `_finishAssistant` decomposition preserves the exact branch ladder (error-row early return, tool role, non-assistant roles, empty-assistant placeholder only when no toolCalls, non-empty assistant append+trajectory) and the single final notify.
- **agent_service_sessions.dart** — loadSession's 4-stage split preserves stage order, every `gen != _loadGeneration` checkpoint (as null/false propagation), phase timing computation points, the AppLog summary, and `unawaited(_refreshHistoryAbove())`. The only dropped statement is a duplicate consecutive gen-check with no await between twins — provably a no-op. `_reloadExternalMessages` decomposition preserves reanchor vs append branches, `_growProviderContext` only on plain append, and the torn-read swallow at the same boundary.

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

No other issues in the settings split: `_connectHosted` preserves statement order, `mounted` guards, analytics calls, and rememberKey timing; `_applyLastConnection` branch extractions are verbatim; no BuildContext-across-async-gap introduced (all `context.l10n` uses in the extension are pre-await/synchronous); public API (SettingsScreen/AgentSettingsForm/SetupScreen signatures) unchanged; `part 'settings_flows.dart'` registration intact; the `_formSetState` bridge correctly avoids invalid_use_of_protected_member.

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. # PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

No other issues in the settings split: `_connectHosted` preserves statement order, `mounted` guards, analytics calls, and rememberKey timing; `_applyLastConnection` branch extractions are verbatim; no BuildContext-across-async-gap introduced (all `context.l10n` uses in the extension are pre-await/synchronous); public API (SettingsScreen/AgentSettingsForm/SetupScreen signatures) unchanged; `part 'settings_flows.dart'` registration intact; the `_formSetState` bridge correctly avoids invalid_use_of_protected_member.

## Findings

New code (line ~640):
```dart
/// Cancels the no-UI widgets' timers and drops them (shared by
/// [forgetAll] and [dispose]).
void _cancelNoUiTimers() { ... }
```
But `dispose()` (line ~651) still carries its **own inline copy** of the timer-cancel loop (`for (final timer in _noUiTimers.values) { timer.cancel(); } _noUiTimers.clear();`) and was not touched by the PR (the only hunk is `forgetAll`). The doc comment "shared by [forgetAll] and [dispose]" is factually wrong, and the duplicate loop the extraction should have removed is still there. No behavior change — either fix the doc or make `dispose()` call the helper. final store = _unpackedStore(manager, appsStore, loader);

Verified both constructors are pure field initializers (`UnpackedWidgetLoader` ctor: `appsStore = appsStore ?? AppsStore(env)`; `AppsStore` ctor assigns platform/readAsset only), so there is no observable behavior change — but the evaluation order did technically change.

The eager `_unpackedStore` also fixes a latent double-construction asymmetry: old code built `AppsStore(manager.env)` once; new code builds it once and passes it to the loader, identical to old. Injection precedence `loader?.appsStore ?? appsStore ?? AppsStore(...)` is byte-identical to old.

**Verdict: no BLOCKING or IMPORTANT findings. All nine files are faithful pure extractions; no behavior change, no compile-risk, no orphaned/dead code, `part`/`part of` registration correct.** Two SUGGESTION-level notes below (one pre-existing quirk surfaced by the refactor, one redundant-parameter nit).

## SUGGESTION-level notes

1. **IMPORTANT-debt, pre-existing (not introduced by this PR)** — `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_builtins_patch.dart:407-429` (`applyParsedPatch`, fuzz classification). Old and new code are byte-identical in logic:
   ```dart
   final alreadyFuzz = _tryFuzz(lines, oldPart, newPart, start + shift, maxOffset, false);
   final reversedFuzz = alreadyFuzz == null ? _tryFuzz(..., true) : null;
   ```

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). # PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

```dart
/// Cancels the no-UI widgets' timers and drops them (shared by

void _cancelNoUiTimers() { ... }
```
But `dispose()` (line ~651) still carries its **own inline copy** of the timer-cancel loop (`for (final timer in _noUiTimers.values) { timer.cancel(); } _noUiTimers.clear();`) and was not touched by the PR (the only hunk is `forgetAll`). The doc comment "shared by [forgetAll] and [dispose]" is factually wrong, and the duplicate loop the extraction should have removed is still there. final store = _unpackedStore(manager, appsStore, loader);

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):

if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)

],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart

  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);

# Sandbox core cluster review — PR #1881 (chore/1848-crap-app-tier4)

**Verdict: no BLOCKING or IMPORTANT findings. All nine files are faithful pure extractions; no behavior change, no compile-risk, no orphaned/dead code, `part`/`part of` registration correct.** Two SUGGESTION-level notes below (one pre-existing quirk surfaced by the refactor, one redundant-parameter nit).

Methodology: per file, compared `git show 59fb4482ce:<path>` (merge-base; earlier gh-1848 tiers are already in it) against the working tree at dcc6dcff81, then full-read every new file. Merge-base fetches confirmed which hunks are actually tier4.

## SUGGESTION-level notes

1. **IMPORTANT-debt, pre-existing (not introduced by this PR)** — `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_builtins_patch.dart:407-429` (`applyParsedPatch`, fuzz classification). Old and new code are byte-identical in logic:
   ```dart
   final alreadyFuzz = _tryFuzz(lines, oldPart, newPart, start + shift, maxOffset, false);
   final reversedFuzz = alreadyFuzz == null ? _tryFuzz(..., true) : null;
   ```
   A hunk matching *only* in reversed form is accepted (reversed patch, like GNU), but a hunk matching in **both** forms (`alreadyFuzz != null && reversedFuzz != null`) falls into the failure branch — arguably it should succeed as already-fuzzed. Semantics unchanged by the extraction; flagged only because the refactor drew attention to it.

2. **SUGGESTION** — `sandbox_builtins_patch.dart:_executeHunk(hunk, state.lines, state)` passes `state.lines` as a separate parameter while `state` already carries `lines`. Harmless (no reassignment during application), but the duplication is a mild smell introduced by the state-holder extraction. Old code had a single `lines` local; threading it once (via `state`) would be cleaner.

## File-by-file confirmation highlights

- **sandbox_ssh.dart** — `_SshArgScan` threads `i/hasRemoteCommand/parsingFlags/expectingOption` exactly like the old locals: `localForwardArg`/`remoteForwardArg` re-check `parsingFlags` before consuming (preserving the `-A`/`-B`/`-L` flag-value shadowing quirk); short-flag cluster loop with `-oBatchMode=yes` special case and `i++/break` semantics identical; `trailingCommandArg` unchanged (blank arg still attaches to `commandParts` via `_argTakesValue` guard). Clean.
- **shell_parser.dart** — tier4 hunks are the `_DqScan` decomposition of `_scanDoubleQuote` and the `substitutionSpanEnd` → `_substitutionParenEnd`/`_substitutionSkip` split (the `_TokenizerState` tokenizer was already in the merge-base). Each piece verified: `_dqContinues`/`_atDqEscape`/`_dqEscape` (escapable set `"` `\` `$` `` ` `` `\n`, `\$` sets `expandable=false`, non-escapable writes `\`+char), `_atDqSubstitution`/`_dqSubstitution` (arithmetic rejection then raw span) — loop order and `unmatched "` throw identical. Substitution skip: backslash → `i+2`, quote/backquote span first, `$ (` depth +1, `)` depth −1, `-1` propagation — identical to the inline base version. Clean.
- **sandbox_builtins_args.dart** (NEW part) — fully read (525 lines). `part of 'sandbox_builtins.dart';` matches the parent's `part` directive; arg-state classes (`CurlArgs`, `JqArgs`, `DiffArgs`, `Base64Args`) live in the parent (lines 57-105) — no duplicate definitions. Every moved helper is called: `_patchApplyArg` chain, `_wgetApplyArg` chain (order and consumption counts identical to the old if-chain, incl. `--output-document=` and wait-flag value consumption), `_curlWriteOutVariables`/`_curlWriteOutToken` chain, `_curlBodyFileSegment`/`_curlBodyCapped`, `_jsonFilterInput`/`_renderJsonFilterOutput`, `_dohFetch`/`_dohAnswers`/`_dohRecord`/`_dohTtl`, `_rdapVcard*`/`_rdapEntityHandle`, `_isDecompress*` predicates + `_decompressEmit` (error → stdout → write → remove order identical), `_base64ApplyArg`/`_base64ApplyWrap`/`_base64OperandArg` (error precedence: decode > wrap > operand; bare `-w` end-of-args error preserved). No orphans.
- **sandbox_builtins_patch.dart** — `parsePatchArgs` loop decomposit…

# Apps-cluster review — PR #1881 (chore/1848-crap-app-tier4)

Method: per-file patches from the GitHub PR files API (base 59fb4482ce → HEAD dcc6dcff81), cross-checked against full old files (raw.githubusercontent @59fb4482ce) and full new local files. No `part` files involved in this cluster — all extractions are private helpers in the same library, so no part-registration checks apply.

## Findings

### SUGGESTION — dynamic_messages.dart:640 — false doc claim / missed dedup
New code (line ~640):
```dart
/// Cancels the no-UI widgets' timers and drops them (shared by
/// [forgetAll] and [dispose]).
void _cancelNoUiTimers() { ... }
```
But `dispose()` (line ~651) still carries its **own inline copy** of the timer-cancel loop (`for (final timer in _noUiTimers.values) { timer.cancel(); } _noUiTimers.clear();`) and was not touched by the PR (the only hunk is `forgetAll`). The doc comment "shared by [forgetAll] and [dispose]" is factually wrong, and the duplicate loop the extraction should have removed is still there. No behavior change — either fix the doc or make `dispose()` call the helper. (Note: `dispose()` also keeps its deliberately *unawaited* `engine.dispose()` loop, which must NOT be merged into the awaited `_disposeEngines` — only the timer loop is the missed dedup.)

### SUGGESTION — unpacked_load_flow.dart:37-42 — inert reordering of pure constructions
Old: `createFolderPicker()` ran first, and when it returned null the function returned **before** `AppsStore(manager.env)` / `UnpackedWidgetLoader(...)` were constructed. New:
```dart
final store = _unpackedStore(manager, appsStore, loader);
final widgetLoader = _unpackedLoader(manager, store, loader);
await _runUnpackedLoad(...); // createFolderPicker() + null-return inside
```
The fallback `AppsStore(manager.env)` and `UnpackedWidgetLoader(env:, appsStore:)` are now constructed even on the no-op host-can't-pick path. Verified both constructors are pure field initializers (`UnpackedWidgetLoader` ctor: `appsStore = appsStore ?? AppsStore(env)`; `AppsStore` ctor assigns platform/readAsset only), so there is no observable behavior change — but the evaluation order did technically change.

### Observation (not a finding) — unpacked_load_flow.dart
The eager `_unpackedStore` also fixes a latent double-construction asymmetry: old code built `AppsStore(manager.env)` once; new code builds it once and passes it to the loader, identical to old. Injection precedence `loader?.appsStore ?? appsStore ?? AppsStore(...)` is byte-identical to old.

## File-by-file verification (all semantically identical unless noted above)

- **app_preflight_probe_io.dart — CLEAN.** `_probeJsEngineLibrary()` is called inside the same `try` that held the platform branch; `Platform.isMacOS || Platform.isIOS` evaluated once at the same point; the `on ArgumentError` fallback open stays inside the per-call try in `_probeJavaScriptCore` (a throwing fallback still propagates to the outer `on Object` exactly as before — the fallback open lives in the catch clause in both versions); the outer `on Object` catch swallows exactly the same failure set (nothing new escapes, nothing new is swallowed). QuickJS env-var fallback chain unchanged.

### 1. SUGGESTION — `flutter_app/lib/services/relay_agent_service.dart:954` — `mail_routed` now notifies listeners once instead of twice

**Old** (`_onHostEvent` switch, base 59fb4482ce): the `mail_routed` case called `if (!silent) notifyListeners();` inside the case (the "Paint NOW" comment), and then the trailing `if (!silent) notifyListeners();` after the switch fired for ALL event types — so `mail_routed` notified **twice** when live.
**New**: `_onHostMailRoutedEvent` (lines 944–955) contains exactly one `if (!silent) notifyListeners();`, and its caller `_onHostStateEvent` does not notify after the `mail_routed` arm (only the `tool_result`/`status` arm via `_onHostProgressEvent` and the default arm via `_onHostDiagnosticsEvent` notify, once each). All other event types keep the identical single notify; only `mail_routed` changes (2 → 1 `notifyListeners()`). The double-notify was almost certainly an accident, so the new code is arguably a fix — but it is a literal behavior deviation in a "zero behavior change" PR and should get a one-line callout in the PR description. No serialization change. `_onToolPairingRepair` early-return guard is the logical inverse of the old `if (nonEmpty && session != null)` — identical.

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],

  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

No other issues in the settings split: `_connectHosted` preserves statement order, `mounted` guards, analytics calls, and rememberKey timing; `_applyLastConnection` branch extractions are verbatim; no BuildContext-across-async-gap introduced (all `context.l10n` uses in the extension are pre-await/synchronous); public API (SettingsScreen/AgentSettingsForm/SetupScreen signatures) unchanged; `part 'settings_flows.dart'` registration intact; the `_formSetState` bridge correctly avoids invalid_use_of_protected_member.

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)

  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)

],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart

  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);

if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). New code (line ~640):
```dart
/// Cancels the no-UI widgets' timers and drops them (shared by
/// [forgetAll] and [dispose]).
void _cancelNoUiTimers() { ... }
```
But `dispose()` (line ~651) still carries its **own inline copy** of the timer-cancel loop (`for (final timer in _noUiTimers.values) { timer.cancel(); } _noUiTimers.clear();`) and was not touched by the PR (the only hunk is `forgetAll`). The doc comment "shared by [forgetAll] and [dispose]" is factually wrong, and the duplicate loop the extraction should have removed is still there. No behavior change — either fix the doc or make `dispose()` call the helper. ```dart

final widgetLoader = _unpackedLoader(manager, store, loader);

Verified both constructors are pure field initializers (`UnpackedWidgetLoader` ctor: `appsStore = appsStore ?? AppsStore(env)`; `AppsStore` ctor assigns platform/readAsset only), so there is no observable behavior change — but the evaluation order did technically change.

### Observation (not a finding) — unpacked_load_flow.dart
The eager `_unpackedStore` also fixes a latent double-construction asymmetry: old code built `AppsStore(manager.env)` once; new code builds it once and passes it to the loader, identical to old. Injection precedence `loader?.appsStore ?? appsStore ?? AppsStore(...)` is byte-identical to old.

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

No other issues in the settings split: `_connectHosted` preserves statement order, `mounted` guards, analytics calls, and rememberKey timing; `_applyLastConnection` branch extractions are verbatim; no BuildContext-across-async-gap introduced (all `context.l10n` uses in the extension are pre-await/synchronous); public API (SettingsScreen/AgentSettingsForm/SetupScreen signatures) unchanged; `part 'settings_flows.dart'` registration intact; the `_formSetState` bridge correctly avoids invalid_use_of_protected_member.

## Per-file verdicts

| File | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `main.dart` | CLEAN — `MyApp.build` split into `_themeListenable`/`_materialApp`/`_navigatorBuilder`/`_wrapScopes`(+core/model/preview); ListenableBuilder listenable, scope nesting order (FahTheme→packs/sessionKeys/onDevice→media/task→chatText/imagePreviews), and all `BootstrapScreen` args identical. |
| `gemma/gemma_cache_section.dart` | CLEAN — `_scan` split into `_presetRows`/`_presetRow`/`_orphanRows`/`_orphanRow`; row order (presets then orphans), per-row `sizeText` closure capture, and lazy `_storageFrom(dialogContext)` evaluation preserved. |
| `gemma/gemma_stream_function.dart` | CLEAN — switch → `runtimeType` map dispatch is equivalent: `UserMessage`/`ToolResultMessage`/`AssistantMessage` are all `final class` (verified `lib/src/types.dart`, `lib/src/context.dart`), so no subclass can escape the map; truncation logic, ellipsis, and pass-through identical. |
| `transformers_js/transformers_js_stream_function.dart` | CLEAN — engine-unload on error, GPU-crash retry predicate, `startChat` callback wiring, and `throwIfCancelled`/`pushTextEnd`/`pushDone` ordering all preserved verbatim in extracted helpers. |
| `transformers_js/transformers_js_types.dart` | CLEAN — `update()` decomposition keeps the expected-bytes guard, monotonic `_maxFraction`, and the ready/prepare/file status-text mapping identical. |

# Review: agent services cluster — PR #1881 (chore/1848-crap-app-tier4)

## Findings

### 1. SUGGESTION — `flutter_app/lib/services/relay_agent_service.dart:954` — `mail_routed` now notifies listeners once instead of twice

**Old** (`_onHostEvent` switch, base 59fb4482ce): the `mail_routed` case called `if (!silent) notifyListeners();` inside the case (the "Paint NOW" comment), and then the trailing `if (!silent) notifyListeners();` after the switch fired for ALL event types — so `mail_routed` notified **twice** when live.
**New**: `_onHostMailRoutedEvent` (lines 944–955) contains exactly one `if (!silent) notifyListeners();`, and its caller `_onHostStateEvent` does not notify after the `mail_routed` arm (only the `tool_result`/`status` arm via `_onHostProgressEvent` and the default arm via `_onHostDiagnosticsEvent` notify, once each). All other event types keep the identical single notify; only `mail_routed` changes (2 → 1 `notifyListeners()`). The double-notify was almost certainly an accident, so the new code is arguably a fix — but it is a literal behavior deviation in a "zero behavior change" PR and should get a one-line callout in the PR description. No rework needed.

## Verified clean (with the specific checks requested)

- **agent_service_events.dart route table** — `_agentEventHandlers` keys are exactly the old switch's 10 cases (AgentStart, TurnStart, MessageUpdate, MessageEnd, ToolExecutionStart, ToolExecutionEnd, ModelRequest, ToolPairingRepair, AgentEnd); unmapped kinds no-op like the old `default: break;`. Await semantics verified: 8 of 10 handlers are synchronous `void` (signatures checked in the new file), so the `async =>` wrappers complete synchronously; `ModelRequestEvent` and `AgentEndEvent` futures are awaited exactly as the old `await` cases did. No serialization change. `_onToolPairingRepair` early-return guard is the logical inverse of the old `if (nonEmpty && session != null)` — identical.
- **relay_agent_service.dart protocol route table** — covers exactly the 10 mapped old cases; `ToolsPutMsg` and raw hello frames stay no-ops as before. Adapter bodies verbatim (`unawaited(_decideApproval)`, `_sessionsQuery?.complete`, `_error`+notify). Casts are safe (runtimeType-keyed, final-class family); null-safety identical.
- **relay_agent_service.dart `_onHostEvent` split** — outer switch routes exactly `delta/thinking_delta/message_done` to the stream family and everything else to the state family; `error`/`debug`/unknown land in diagnostics (ignore + repaint, matching the old default); no fall-through changes. `_finishAssistant` decomposition preserves the exact branch ladder (error-row early return, tool role, non-assistant roles, empty-assistant placeholder only when no toolCalls, non-empty assistant append+trajectory) and the single final notify.

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. # PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}

Old code inferred the concrete type from `createCalendarService()` at the use site. Compiles fine (flutter_app's analysis_options is plain `flutter_lints`, no `strict-inference`), but it defeats static checking on `calendar.isAvailable` / `calendar.events(...)` inside the extracted methods and deviates from the file's otherwise fully-typed style. Should be `CalendarApi calendar` (type is imported via `calendar_service.dart`).

- **span_grid_delegate.dart `_packSpan`** — traced exhaustively, EQUIVALENT. Old inner structure: grow rows (`while (rows.length < cursorRow + h)`) → `fits = cursorCol + w <= crossAxisCount` → `dr`/`dc` scan with `&& fits` short-circuit → mark/add/`cursorCol += w`/break → wrap `if (++cursorCol + w > crossAxisCount) { cursorRow++; cursorCol = 0; }`. Wrap condition byte-identical; success path returns `(cursorRow, cursorCol + w)` which the caller destructures — matches old `cursorCol += w; break`. No off-by-one, no infinite-loop change (cursor advancement identical on both paths). `w`/`h` clamping identical.
- **quick_switcher.dart** — contains no fuzzy matching; the recents logic (`_recentNetworkIds`, `i < recents.length && i < 7`, `_digitKeys[i + 3]!`) is untouched. # PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

No other issues in the settings split: `_connectHosted` preserves statement order, `mounted` guards, analytics calls, and rememberKey timing; `_applyLastConnection` branch extractions are verbatim; no BuildContext-across-async-gap introduced (all `context.l10n` uses in the extension are pre-await/synchronous); public API (SettingsScreen/AgentSettingsForm/SetupScreen signatures) unchanged; `part 'settings_flows.dart'` registration intact; the `_formSetState` bridge correctly avoids invalid_use_of_protected_member.

| `main.dart` | CLEAN — `MyApp.build` split into `_themeListenable`/`_materialApp`/`_navigatorBuilder`/`_wrapScopes`(+core/model/preview); ListenableBuilder listenable, scope nesting order (FahTheme→packs/sessionKeys/onDevice→media/task→chatText/imagePreviews), and all `BootstrapScreen` args identical. |
| `gemma/gemma_cache_section.dart` | CLEAN — `_scan` split into `_presetRows`/`_presetRow`/`_orphanRows`/`_orphanRow`; row order (presets then orphans), per-row `sizeText` closure capture, and lazy `_storageFrom(dialogContext)` evaluation preserved. |
| `gemma/gemma_stream_function.dart` | CLEAN — switch → `runtimeType` map dispatch is equivalent: `UserMessage`/`ToolResultMessage`/`AssistantMessage` are all `final class` (verified `lib/src/types.dart`, `lib/src/context.dart`), so no subclass can escape the map; truncation logic, ellipsis, and pass-through identical. |

| `transformers_js/transformers_js_types.dart` | CLEAN — `update()` decomposition keeps the expected-bytes guard, monotonic `_maxFraction`, and the ready/prepare/file status-text mapping identical. |

Old code inferred the concrete type from `createCalendarService()` at the use site. Compiles fine (flutter_app's analysis_options is plain `flutter_lints`, no `strict-inference`), but it defeats static checking on `calendar.isAvailable` / `calendar.events(...)` inside the extracted methods and deviates from the file's otherwise fully-typed style. # Apps-cluster review — PR #1881 (chore/1848-crap-app-tier4)

Method: per-file patches from the GitHub PR files API (base 59fb4482ce → HEAD dcc6dcff81), cross-checked against full old files (raw.githubusercontent @59fb4482ce) and full new local files. No `part` files involved in this cluster — all extractions are private helpers in the same library, so no part-registration checks apply.

## Findings

### SUGGESTION — dynamic_messages.dart:640 — false doc claim / missed dedup
New code (line ~640):
```dart
/// Cancels the no-UI widgets' timers and drops them (shared by
/// [forgetAll] and [dispose]).
void _cancelNoUiTimers() { ... }
```
But `dispose()` (line ~651) still carries its **own inline copy** of the timer-cancel loop (`for (final timer in _noUiTimers.values) { timer.cancel(); } _noUiTimers.clear();`) and was not touched by the PR (the only hunk is `forgetAll`). The doc comment "shared by [forgetAll] and [dispose]" is factually wrong, and the duplicate loop the extraction should have removed is still there. No behavior change — either fix the doc or make `dispose()` call the helper. (Note: `dispose()` also keeps its deliberately *unawaited* `engine.dispose()` loop, which must NOT be merged into the awaited `_disposeEngines` — only the timer loop is the missed dedup.)

### SUGGESTION — unpacked_load_flow.dart:37-42 — inert reordering of pure constructions
Old: `createFolderPicker()` ran first, and when it returned null the function returned **before** `AppsStore(manager.env)` / `UnpackedWidgetLoader(...)` were constructed. New:
```dart
final store = _unpackedStore(manager, appsStore, loader);
final widgetLoader = _unpackedLoader(manager, store, loader);
await _runUnpackedLoad(...); // createFolderPicker() + null-return inside
```
The fallback `AppsStore(manager.env)` and `UnpackedWidgetLoader(env:, appsStore:)` are now constructed even on the no-op host-can't-pick path. Verified both constructors are pure field initializers (`UnpackedWidgetLoader` ctor: `appsStore = appsStore ?? AppsStore(env)`; `AppsStore` ctor assigns platform/readAsset only), so there is no observable behavior change — but the evaluation order did technically change.

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):

if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)

],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):

  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

No other issues in the settings split: `_connectHosted` preserves statement order, `mounted` guards, analytics calls, and rememberKey timing; `_applyLastConnection` branch extractions are verbatim; no BuildContext-across-async-gap introduced (all `context.l10n` uses in the extension are pre-await/synchronous); public API (SettingsScreen/AgentSettingsForm/SetupScreen signatures) unchanged; `part 'settings_flows.dart'` registration intact; the `_formSetState` bridge correctly avoids invalid_use_of_protected_member.

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)

],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart

  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);

  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)

# PR #1881 review — UI screens cluster (12 files)

## Findings

### 1. BLOCKING — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/settings_flows.dart:133` (+ `settings.dart` build, ~line 873): stale-model note (and structurally the CORS note) no longer rendered for on-device providers

**Old** (`settings.dart` @ 59fb4482ce, `build()`):
```dart
if (!_showProviderListOnly) ...[
  if (_isOnDevice) _buildWebLlmFields(theme)
  else if (_isGemma) _buildGemmaFields(theme)
  else if (_isTransformersJs) _buildTransformersJsFields(theme)
  else ...[ /* key/model/url fields */ ],
  if (corsNote != null) ...[ /* CORS note row */ ],        // sibling of the if/else chain
  if (_staleModelNote != null) ...[ /* stale-model note row */ ],
],
```
**New** (`settings_flows.dart`):
```dart
Widget _buildProviderConfigFields(...) {
  if (_isOnDevice) return _buildWebLlmFields(theme);        // line 133 — early return
  if (_isGemma) return _buildGemmaFields(theme);
  if (_isTransformersJs) return _buildTransformersJsFields(theme);
  return _buildStandardFields(theme, selection, corsNote);  // notes only inside here
}
```
`_staleModelNote` is set **exclusively** by the on-device verify paths (`_verifyWebLlmCache`, `_verifyGemmaInstalled`, `_verifyTransformersJsCache` — "cached weights are stale", "N of M installed" warnings) and is reset to null by `_selectProvider`, so it can only be non-null while an on-device provider is selected. By hoisting the notes into `_buildStandardFields` (hosted-only), the extraction made that note unreachable — a real user-facing behavior change in a PR claiming zero behavior change (the note's state setter is now dead UI). The CORS note is structurally dropped the same way but is practically unaffected (`ProviderPreset.cors` returns null for webllm/gemma/transformersJs — verified in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/providers/provider_preset.dart`). Fix: render `..._buildConfigNotes(theme, corsNote)` after `_buildProviderConfigFields(...)` in `settings.dart` build, as siblings, matching the old tree.

No other issues in the settings split: `_connectHosted` preserves statement order, `mounted` guards, analytics calls, and rememberKey timing; `_applyLastConnection` branch extractions are verbatim; no BuildContext-across-async-gap introduced (all `context.l10n` uses in the extension are pre-await/synchronous); public API (SettingsScreen/AgentSettingsForm/SetupScreen signatures) unchanged; `part 'settings_flows.dart'` registration intact; the `_formSetState` bridge correctly avoids invalid_use_of_protected_member.

## Per-file verdicts

| File | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `main.dart` | CLEAN — `MyApp.build` split into `_themeListenable`/`_materialApp`/`_navigatorBuilder`/`_wrapScopes`(+core/model/preview); ListenableBuilder listenable, scope nesting order (FahTheme→packs/sessionKeys/onDevice→media/task→chatText/imagePreviews), and all `BootstrapScreen` args identical. |
| `gemma/gemma_cache_section.dart` | CLEAN — `_scan` split into `_presetRows`/`_presetRow`/`_orphanRows`/`_orphanRow`; row order (presets then orphans), per-row `sizeText` closure capture, and lazy `_storageFrom(dialogContext)` evaluation preserved. |
| `gemma/gemma_stream_function.dart` | CLEAN — switch → `runtimeType` map dispatch is equivalent: `UserMessage`/`ToolResultMessage`/`AssistantMessage` are all `final class` (verified `lib/src/types.dart`, `lib/src/context.dart`), so no subclass can escape the map; truncation logic, ellipsis, and pass-through identical. |
| `transformers_js/transformers_js_stream_function.dart` | CLEAN — engine-unload on error, GPU-crash retry predicate, `startChat` callback wiring, and `throwIfCancelled`/`pushTextEnd`/`pushDone` ordering all preserved verbatim in extracted helpers. |
| `transformers_js/transformers_js_types.dart` | CLEAN — `update()` decomposition keeps the expected-bytes guard, monotonic `_maxFraction`, and the ready/prepare/file status-text mapping identical. |
